subject: Chemistry
title: Atomic Structure
summary: Atoms mein electrons (Thomson), ek chhota dense positive nucleus (Rutherford) jismein protons aur neutrons (Chadwick) hain. Rutherford ka model atom ki stability aur line spectra nahi samjha paaya.
Light waves ki tarah bhi aur E = hν energy wale photons ki tarah bhi behave karti hai. Photoelectric effect aur hydrogen ke line spectrum ne dikhaya ki energy quantised hai.
Bohr ka model hydrogen-like atoms mein angular momentum quantise karta hai (mvr = nh/2π) aur energies Eₙ = −13.6 Z²/n² eV deta hai, jisse hydrogen spectrum samajh aata hai.

Quantum mechanics ne orbits ki jagah orbitals diye. Chaar quantum numbers (n, l, m_l, m_s) har electron ko describe karte hain; orbitals Aufbau principle, Pauli exclusion principle aur Hund's rule se bharte hain.

formulas.name: Photoelectric effect
formulas.formula: hν = φ + K_max;  K_max = eV₀;  φ = hν₀
formulas.mistake: Intensity electrons ki sankhya badalti hai, unki maximum energy nahi — confuse mat karo.

formulas.name: Radius of Bohr orbit
formulas.when: H-like species (H, He⁺, Li²⁺) mein orbit ka size.
formulas.mistake: r n² se badhta hai par 1/Z se ghatta hai — dono dhyan mein rakho.

formulas.name: Rydberg formula
formulas.mistake: Lyman n₁ = 1 (UV), Balmer n₁ = 2 (visible), Paschen 3, Brackett 4, Pfund 5 (IR) — series mix mat karo.

formulas.name: Number of spectral lines
formulas.formula: from level n down to 1: n(n − 1)/2
formulas.when: Excited atoms ke sample se nikli lines.

formulas.name: Heisenberg's uncertainty principle
formulas.when: Position aur momentum ek saath jaanne ki limit.
formulas.mistake: Ye fundamental limit hai, measuring instrument ki kami nahi — galat mat samjho.

formulas.name: Quantum numbers
formulas.mistake: l kabhi n ke barabar nahi ho sakta.

formulas.name: Nodes
formulas.formula: radial nodes = n − l − 1;  angular nodes = l;  total = n − 1

formulas.name: Orbital capacity
formulas.when: s, p, d, f aur shell mein maximum electrons.

formulas.name: (n + l) rule
formulas.formula: lower (n + l) fills first; if equal, lower n fills first

topics.title: Discovery of subatomic particles
topics.explain: Electron: cathode rays, e/m J.J. Thomson ne naapa; charge Millikan ke oil-drop experiment se. Proton: canal (anode) rays. Neutron: Chadwick (1932). Atomic number Z = protons; mass number A = protons + neutrons. Isotopes: same Z (¹H, ²H); isobars: same A (⁴⁰Ar, ⁴⁰Ca).

topics.title: Atomic models
topics.explain: Thomson: plum pudding. Rutherford (gold foil par α-scattering): atom zyadatar khaali, beech mein chhota dense positive nucleus; fail kyunki ghoomta electron radiate karke andar gir jaana chahiye. Bohr ne ise sirf hydrogen-like atoms ke liye theek kiya.

topics.title: Electromagnetic radiation
topics.explain: c = νλ. Black-body radiation aur photoelectric effect ke liye Planck ka quantum idea chahiye tha: energy hν ke packets mein. Line (atomic) spectra elements ke fingerprints jaise hain.

topics.title: Limitations of Bohr's model
topics.explain: Sirf one-electron species par kaam karta hai; fine structure, Zeeman (magnetic) aur Stark (electric) effects ya chemical bonding nahi samjhata, aur exact orbits dekar uncertainty principle ke khilaaf jaata hai.

topics.title: Quantum mechanical model
topics.explain: Schrödinger equation se wave functions ψ; |ψ|² probability density. Orbital woh region jahan electron milne ki probability sabse zyada. Shapes: s orbitals spherical, p dumb-bell (px, py, pz), d zyadatar clover-leaf (dz² alag).

topics.title: Filling rules
topics.explain: Aufbau: pehle kam energy. Pauli: do electrons ke chaaron quantum numbers same nahi. Hund: degenerate orbitals mein electrons pehle akele parallel spin se, phir pair. Half-filled aur fully filled subshells extra stable: Cr = [Ar]3d⁵4s¹, Cu = [Ar]3d¹⁰4s¹.

topics.title: Energy of orbitals
topics.explain: Hydrogen mein energy sirf n par (2s = 2p). Many-electron atoms mein n aur l dono par, kyunki andar ke electrons bahar walon ko alag-alag shield karte hain (s sabse zyada penetrate karta hai).

ratta: Radial nodes n − l − 1;  angular nodes l.
